sources.entry: AppleEvents - Unofficial Apple Events app for macOS.

summary.one_liner: An unofficial macOS app for watching Apple Events streams, which its README says is no longer maintained.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that the app is no longer maintained. It says Apple now streams Apple Events through the Apple TV app on the Mac, and points to the Apple Developer app, the unofficial WWDC app for macOS, or a web browser as alternatives. It does not describe features, build steps, or technical details. The repository was listed under the Video section of an open-source macOS apps list.
use_cases: watch Apple Events keynote streams on a Mac
find a current alternative for viewing Apple Events
review an archived unofficial macOS video app
notable: Unofficial macOS client for Apple Events streams
README says the project is no longer maintained
README points to Apple TV app as the current way to watch
caveats: No longer maintained, according to the README
Apple now streams Apple Events in the Apple TV app, so this app is likely obsolete
README gives no setup or build instructions
